name: electricchic/electricchic
description: Hebrew-first, RTL-native WooCommerce platform for a physical bicycle shop in Israel.

scripts-descriptions.lint: PHPCS — WordPress Coding Standards, PHP 8.2 compatibility, and the project's HPOS sniff.
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: PHPCBF — auto-fix the PHPCS violations that can be fixed safely.
scripts-descriptions.lint:summary: PHPCS with a per-file summary rather than full detail.
scripts-descriptions.analyse: PHPStan level 5 with WordPress and WooCommerce stubs.
scripts-descriptions.sniff:selftest: Prove the HPOS sniff still catches direct order post-meta access.
scripts-descriptions.check: Everything CI runs for PHP. Run this before opening a pull request.
scripts-descriptions.test: PHPUnit — pure business logic, no WordPress bootstrap.
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: PHPUnit with a text coverage summary (needs Xdebug or PCOV).
